title: Rational operation comparison interfaces
statement: Use the finite-field datum, completed integral and raw rational constructible categories, derived operations and rational Verdier data. A permitted-pair lift homPair restricts the identity product functor to permitted rational Hom pairs. tensorLeft fixes the first tensor input; homRight fixes the first Hom input; homDual fixes its target. coefficientUnit is the localization of the constructed completed regular integral module. dualFormula is D_Y.rightOp followed by opposite completed rational pullback and D_X. ExceptionalIdentification consists of a comparison from the normalized system right adjoint to dualFormula, the transported adjunction against actual compact support, and the equations preserving its unit and counit. Identification packages integral dualizing data, rational dualities, their Hom identifications and exceptional comparison. dualScalar is the given source-duality comparison followed contravariantly by the inverse target-duality and pullback scalar comparisons. ScalarCompatibility records both normalized duality extensions and equality with the actual exceptional mate comparison. HomScalarCompatibility is the equation preserving evaluation under the recorded rational tensor and Hom scalar comparisons. Conclusion existentially asserts systems at f and at the structure map, then for every finite-field embedding asserts the two identifications, their scalar comparison, both Hom scalar squares and both structure dualizing identifications. These are interfaces, not existence assertions except for the proposition Conclusion itself.
